title: Zilber-Pink Unlikely Intersection Conjecture
exact_target: For subvarieties of mixed Shimura varieties and semiabelian varieties, prove the Zilber--Pink finiteness prediction for maximal atypical intersections with special subvarieties. An intersection is atypical if its dimension exceeds the dimension expected from the ambient space. The general question encompasses the relevant Mordell--Lang and Andr\'e--Oort settings, rather than only a single family of ambient varieties.
